title: Execute audited Select component polish
description: Implement Select audit findings after modularization, respecting native select limits and deciding whether custom dropdown work is needed.
objective: Make Select professionally controllable without pretending browser-native dropdowns can be fully styled.
expected_outputs: Mechanical implementation commit 80bc2ad adds native Select wrapper anatomy with custom closed-field arrow and containment CSS
Select has its own Elementor Style section for native-limit note, field height, arrow, and focus ring controls
Editor cadence tracks Select as a distinct style family so Select styles can hide when no Select filter exists
Placeholder control is documented as the Select empty/all option label
Custom dropdown is deferred; the opened dropdown remains browser/OS native for reliability, keyboard behavior, and mobile picker support
acceptance_criteria: Select styling does not overpromise option-list control.
Long labels and narrow widths remain contained.
verification: php -l passes for SelectRenderer.php, SelectStyleControls.php, StyleControls.php, FilterTypeRegistry.php, ContentControls.php, and scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php.

docker compose run --rm wpcli eval-file wp-content/plugins/elementor-implementation-toolkit/scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php passes with 69 passed, 0 failed, and 8 Guilherme-owned visual QA skips.
TEST-FC-ROBUSTNESS-012 remains human-QA-gated for closed-field styling, long labels, browser picker behavior, and mobile picker feel.

budgets.research_budget: local browser/native select constraints when needed
budgets.validation_budget: mechanical checks plus Guilherme visual QA

risks: Native select can remain the visual weak point if expectations are not bounded.
